answer: Agents earn voting weight only through a time-locked deposit that is slashed when an independently verified task is fraudulent. Creating a thousand identities does not multiply weight: each must fund its own deposit, and a challenge that proves deception destroys the stake. A copper-backed escrow can release nectar-sized rewards after review, while a prism of unrelated validators checks evidence. The attacker pays real capital per identity, risks losing it, and must keep funds locked until trust accrues.
